headline: Ghana Gold Buyers Call for Infrastructure Support for 70% Local Gold Refining Target
summary: The Chamber of Licensed Gold Buyers urged Ghana's government to provide strategic financing and infrastructure to achieve its target of refining 70% of small-scale mining gold locally by 2027.
why: Ghana is Africa's largest gold producer, seeking to capture higher economic value by refining raw bullion locally rather than exporting crude dore.

impacts.name: Ghana Mining Sector
impacts.why: Increasing domestic gold refining retains higher value within Ghana's domestic supply chain.
